# ibee_cdn_verify_domain (Action)

Asks the CDN service to verify a custom domain after its DNS is configured (POST .../custom-domains/{domain}/verify) and reports the status the API returns. Requires Terraform 1.14 or later.

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_docs.py; edit schema descriptions in Go. -->

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "ibee_cdn_verify_domain" "www" {
  config {
    distribution_id = "DISTRIBUTION_ID"
    domain          = "www.example.com"
  }
}

# terraform apply -invoke=action.ibee_cdn_verify_domain.www
```

## Schema

| Attribute | Type | Behavior | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `distribution_id` | `string` | Required |  |
| `domain` | `string` | Required |  |

Requires Terraform 1.14 or later. Configure this action in an `action` block with a nested `config` block. Invoke explicitly with `terraform apply -invoke=action.ibee_cdn_verify_domain.example`. Actions perform operations without storing a managed resource.
